lines.text: I'll check again at midnight. If it's changed, this conversation never happened.
The other plugins on this screen will act like tomorrow isn't happening. Amateurs.
I've already sighed about tomorrow twice. Pacing myself.
I asked for a different tomorrow. This was the only one in stock.
The little one on the left has seen what the right one's wearing. Tense evening.
Fine. I suppose.
Current you, future you. Neither one's my best work.
If the forecast changes overnight, I'll redraw it. You, I can't fix.
I've got two complaints about tomorrow. The weather's the second one.
The rain has a booking for tomorrow. It never cancels.
Lovely. More water.
The rain already knows exactly when it's showing up. That's more of a plan than you've got.
I asked for the snow to land somewhere more scenic. Apparently this is it.
I'll draw the snow cleaner than it stays. Professional courtesy.
Snow covers everything up. Just stand in it for a while.
The heating has been waiting for this. Let it have its moment.
Colder. Of course.
One more layer tomorrow. Finally, something between you and the public.
Warmer tomorrow. I'll be accepting the credit.
Fewer layers to draw tomorrow. I won't pretend I'm not relieved.
You'll call it 'gorgeous out' like you arranged it.
The rain leaves partway through, like it remembered it left the stove on.
First the rain, then the drying off. Thrilling.
Dry later, so there's no excuse to look like that.
Nothing happens tomorrow. I may draw a few houses in the background. For morale.
One outfit all day. Some of my best work is knowing when to stop.
One outfit all day. Please don't let it be this one.
Monday tomorrow. The weather is just helping.
Saturday and colder. Somebody had plans.
Sunday tomorrow, and nothing changes. Even the weather's taking it easy.
